This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include codes from http://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 404684003 (Clinical finding (finding))
  • Include codes from http://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 71388002 (Procedure)

name: ProcedureReasonCodes
title: Procedure Reason Codes
description: This example value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate a reason for a procedure.
